```{r}
library(sf)
parcels_west_tamar <- st_read("dataset/LIST_PARCELS_WEST_TAMAR/LIST_PARCELS_WEST_TAMAR.shp")
address <- st_read("dataset/LIST_ADDRESS_POINTS_STATEWIDE/list_address_points_statewide.shp") 

address %>% filter(PID=="1481512") %>% select(PID,ST_NO_FROM,STREET,ST_TY_CODE,LOCALITY,POSTCODE)
```





```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)

req <- c("ST_NO_FROM","STREET","ST_TYPE","LOCALITY","POSTCODE")

# treat blanks as NA
address <- address %>%
  mutate(
    STREET_NO_FROM = na_if(str_squish(as.character(ST_NO_FROM)), ""),
    STREET     = na_if(str_squish(as.character(STREET)), ""),
    ST_TYPE = na_if(str_squish(as.character(ST_TYPE)), ""),
    LOCALITY   = na_if(str_squish(as.character(LOCALITY)), ""),
    POSTCODE   = na_if(as.character(POSTCODE), "")
  )

na_summary <- address %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%                                  # <<< drop geometry here
  summarise(across(all_of(req), ~ sum(is.na(.)),
                   .names = "na_{.col}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("na_"),                        # <<< pivot only NA columns
               names_to = "field", values_to = "n_na") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n_na / nrow(address), 2))
na_summary

```

```{r}
address <- address %>%
  mutate(
    full_address = str_squish(
      paste0(ST_NO_FROM, " ", STREET, " ", ST_TY_CODE, " ",
             LOCALITY, " TAS ", POSTCODE, " ","Australia")
    )

address %>% filter(PID=="1481512") %>% select(PID,full_address)
```

```{r}
address_clean <- address %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%   # drop geometry for faster joins
  select(PID, full_address)
  
parcels_with_address <- parcels_west_tamar %>%
  left_join(address_clean, by = "PID") %>%     # use inner_join() if you only want PIDs that match
  select(PID, full_address, geometry)   


parcels_with_address %>% filter(PID=="1481512") %>% select(PID,full_address)
```

```{r}
property_listing<-read_csv("results/tas_listings_with_price_and_geocode.csv")
View(property_listing)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)

# Helper: drop geometry if an object is sf
drop_geom <- function(x) if (inherits(x, "sf")) sf::st_drop_geometry(x) else x

# 1) Normalise address strings into a join key
norm_addr <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_upper() %>%
    str_replace_all(",", " ") %>%                      # remove commas
    str_replace_all("\\bAUSTRALIA\\b|\\bTASMANIA\\b", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bROAD\\b|\\bRD\\.?\\b", "RD") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bSTREET\\b|\\bST\\.?\\b", "ST") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bAVENUE\\b|\\bAVE\\.?\\b", "AVE") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bDRIVE\\b|\\bDR\\.?\\b", "DR") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bLANE\\b|\\bLN\\.?\\b", "LN") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bCRESCENT\\b|\\bCRES\\.?\\b", "CRES") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\bHIGHWAY\\b|\\bHWY\\.?\\b", "HWY") %>%
    str_squish()
}

# 2) Prepare both datasets with a common key
parcels_std <- parcels_with_address %>%
  mutate(addr_key = norm_addr(full_address),
         PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  rename(parcel_full_address = full_address)

props_std <- property_listing %>%
  mutate(addr_key = norm_addr(full_address)) %>%
  rename(listing_full_address = full_address)

# 3) Join (keep parcel geometry). Use left_join to retain all parcels.
joined_exact <- parcels_std %>%
  left_join(drop_geom(props_std), by = "addr_key")

# Keep only the columns you care about (geometry, PID, address(es) + any listing fields you want)
result_exact <- joined_exact %>%
  select(PID, parcel_full_address, listing_full_address, addr_key, geometry, everything())

# (optional) quick match-rate check
match_rate <- mean(!is.na(result_exact$listing_full_address))
cat("Exact-match rate:", round(100*match_rate, 1), "%\n")
View(result_exact)


```
